title: Mixed Event — It's On! Wonder Halloween! — Episode1 A Fresh Start

meta.Event Outline: Tsukasa and the rest of WxS begin preparing a Halloween performance for Phoenix Wonderland's Show Contest. However, Rui starts acting unusual after an incident...

rows.Line: Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay... I think I have everything I need for today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I could use those lights for the final scene too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Time to put on another fantastic show!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That flash of light... What was it?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You remember now, don't you, Black Knight? You used to wield your sword to protect people, to keep peace.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So those shinies were his memories coming back? It looked so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right... I'd forgotten what was really important to me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I shall vow to only ever brandish my sword in the name of peace as I had in the past!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The Black Knight was once again back on the righteous path and peace returned to the world.
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What a terrific story!
Maybe I could play a part too♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! I'm not surprised!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The light effect at the end deserves a special mention. It was a very clever lighting scheme!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, so it was worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And the part where Tsukasa leaps almost up to the ceiling was so awesome♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I loved that bit too! You shot up like a rocket, Tsukasa! It was so cool♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought he was going to go through the roof.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, yes. Being lifted up by hidden wires...
To be honest, I was scared senseless.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you need to challenge yourself to make extraordinary performances! And I aim to be the world's greatest star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If it's for the sake of entertaining my audience, I'll pull off even the most dangerous stunts with elegance and grace!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, well, it's certainly great to have a reliable guy such as yourself on the team.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm thinking of adding in a new part, especially for a star of your caliber. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, a new part...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What sort of thing do you have in mind? Is it gonna be fun?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have a bad feeling about this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't worry, I've made due considerations for health and safety. Although that performance may require some courage.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm?
Who's that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's Len!
Hey, Leeen!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Like... Kagamine Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yup, that's me!
Nice to meet you all♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was coming to see your show, but on the way here, I saw some plushies having an argument.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: By the time I got them to calm down and make up, the show was over! I'm so gutted that I missed it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I was wondering where you were.
It's a pity you couldn't make it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hmm... I feel sorry for Len missing out.
Why don't we do another performance for him?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
YEESSS!
I'll even do it a hundred times!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A hundred might be a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I suppose we could do it once more. It'll be good practice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then it's settled!
Feast your eyes on our wonderful show!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Awesome!
Everyone, thank you so much!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aah, I had TONS of fun!
And Len really liked our show too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. We also got some pointers for improvement.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our big performance tomorrow is guaranteed to be a resounding success!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure it will go without a hitch... It might be time to start thinking of what our next show after that will be.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Already?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why not? I already have some new ideas to play around with to make our next show even more entertaining.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Is that possible?!
I'm so hyped♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You'll have me doing even trickier stunts, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Shouldn't you be pleased? It'll give you the attention you so badly crave, Mr. Self-proclaimed Star.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I think you meant to say acclaimed star!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's going to be so amazing, Tsukasa!
Every show Rui comes up with is so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fun, yes... But I'd rather not have a jetpack strapped to my back again, or anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not your cup of tea, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It would make for a truly fantastic spectacle, worthy of a true star such as...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, fine...!
I'll do whatever you need me to do!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If it's to put on a good show, then I'll do anything!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As long as you can promise me that whatever antics you have me do will make the audience roar with delight.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, you can be sure of that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's definitely going to be a crowd-pleaser of the highest caliber.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ascending to the stage from the seats won't have enough of an impact. He needs to make a powerful impression as a knight...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I've got it! That will definitely be better! But I'll have to assess its practicality and safety first.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You look like you've been having the time of your life lately.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, have I?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah. You look like you're having fun.
Before, you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you mean, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You seemed bored all the time before, but now you keep making this weird face.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How is it weird? Should I be concerned?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Jokes aside, you may be right...
I'm finally living my life.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Being able to put my ideas into action feels amazing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyways, the stage is sorted and we're ready to hold our show. I'll start planning the next one in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... Maybe I can make it easier for Tsukasa by reusing some of the gimmicks that worked with him last time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'm happy for you, Rui.
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Let's get started with the rehearsal...!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Miss!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: A notice about an event that's to be held here just came in...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
An event?
Dad didn't mention anything about that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What sort of event is it?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Here's the flyer.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's see...
The First Phoenix Show Contest...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Did you just say Show Contest...?!
